verdict.rationale: Morph is an inference and tooling API with model gateway, Fast Apply, Compact, Reflexes and MCP. It is the kind of developer platform where buyers could reasonably ask about workflow versioning, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no user-defined automations that can be versioned, reviewed or rolled back. The canary traffic trials, dated model snapshots and versioned API paths concern provider migration and API stability, not the user's automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
